rule.statement: A court is not entitled to read words into an Act of parliament unless clear reasons for it is to be found within the four corners of the Act itself
rule.supporting_quote: A court is not entitled to read words into an Act of parliament unless clear reasons for it is to be found within the four corners of the Act itself Vickers Sons & Maxim Ltd. vs. Evans (1910) AC 444 at 445.
rule.statute_citation_verbatim: Vickers Sons & Maxim Ltd. vs. Evans (1910) AC 444 at 445
